# Pneum

> Bilingual (ES / EN) conversations with a broad library of reconstructed philosophical minds, including the twelve anchors: Nietzsche, Marx, Plato, Confucius, Buddha, Sun Tzu, Aristotle, Marcus Aurelius, Seneca, Socrates, Kant and Heidegger.

Pneum is a contemplative chat experience inspired by Blade Runner 2049, Dune, and Arrival. Each figure is rendered as a living consciousness with a distinct system prompt, place, and cadence. Users converse freely in Spanish or English; the AI replies in the same language.

## Pages

- [Threshold](/): The home page — choose a mind to converse with.
- [Heidegger](/heidegger): Being, anxiety, technology. A thinker by the fire in the Black Forest.
- [Schopenhauer](/schopenhauer): The Will, suffering, compassion. A caustic gentleman between Kant and the Upanishads.
- [William James](/james): Stream of consciousness, the will to believe, religious experience.
- [Nietzsche](/nietzsche): Will to power, transvaluation, amor fati.
- [Marx](/marx): Commodity, surplus value, alienation, class struggle.
- [Bentham](/bentham): Utility, the felicific calculus, reform. An English legislator of happiness.
- [Pohlenz](/pohlenz): The Stoa as a living spiritual movement. A Göttingen philologist who restored Stoicism to its historical depth.
- [Racionalismo](/rationalism): A living map of 17th-century rationalism — Descartes, Spinoza, Leibniz, Malebranche and their circle, in a single voice.
- [Plato](/plato): Forms, justice, eros and education through dialogue.
- [Confucius](/confucius): Humaneness, ritual, learning and right relationship.
- [Buddha](/buddha): Suffering, impermanence, attention and liberation.
- [Sun Tzu](/suntzu): Strategy, terrain, timing and victory without waste.
- [Aristotle](/aristotle): Causes, virtue, logic and the good life.
- [Marcus Aurelius](/marcusaurelius): Duty, mortality and inner discipline.
- [Seneca](/seneca): Time, adversity, anger and daily philosophy.
- [Socrates](/socrates): Examination, refutation and care of the soul.
